answer: A farm of 120 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are logged in glacier, queued in grove, and quartz publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 98 identities per epoch. A farm of 4773 identities would post 2921 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
